status: baseline established; foundation-model and EEGNet experiments not run

source_conditions.medium: N-back task 2: arithmetic 1-back (dataset documentation calls this medium)

label_interpretation.caveat: These are dataset task-condition labels, not direct measurements of an individual's psychological workload or stress. The README does not define numeric phase IDs; the existing pipeline presumes phase 2 is active.

split.notes: Each participant is kept within a single fold. Metrics below are pooled out-of-fold results, not a separately pre-registered final test.

dataset.class_balancing: No class reweighting is reported; class counts are nearly balanced.

environment.gpu_detected: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050, 4 GB VRAM; not usable by the installed CPU-only PyTorch

gradient_boosting_baseline.selection: Selected by highest grouped cross-validation macro F1 among the existing classical baselines.

eegnet.reason: No EEGNet implementation or raw-signal preprocessing/evaluation path exists in the current pipeline.

LaBraM_frozen.compatibility: Unverified against the official implementation's channel embedding and input path. Its published preprocessing uses 200 Hz, microvolt-scale EEG, 0.1-75 Hz filtering, and a 50 Hz notch; a valid exact channel mapping and raw-signal conversion have not been implemented.

EEGPT_frozen.compatibility: The official 58-channel, 256 Hz, 4-second model exposes named channel IDs that include all 14 Emotiv channel names, so a no-fabrication subset is possible. Resampling, input units/preprocessing, official checkpoint loading, and inference have not been validated.

BIOT_frozen.compatibility: The available 16-channel checkpoint expects a named bipolar TCP montage. The UAB files provide 14 Emotiv electrode channels, not that montage; missing derivations will not be synthesized or duplicated.

experiment_stages.stage_2_checkpoint_smoke_test: not_run; no pretrained model was loaded

conclusion: No claim about pretrained-model improvement is supported. Preserve the existing production model; further work requires a validated raw-signal preprocessing and model-input mapping, plus a bounded official-checkpoint smoke test.
